title: Studio City Recreation Center – New Gymnasium (Re-Bid) (PRJ20404) (W.O.
text:
Studio City Recreation Center – New Gymnasium (Re-Bid) (PRJ20404) (W.O.
  #E170267B) Project – Request Authority to  Increase Construction
  Contingency – Adjust the Funding for Construction Contract No. 4069 –
  Exemption from the Provisions of the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA) Pursuant to Article 5, Section 15061(b)(3) [where it can be seen with
  Certainty that there is No Possibility that the Activity in Question may have a
  Significant Effect on the Environment, the Activity is Not Subject to CEQA] of
  California CEQA Guidelines and Article II, Section 2(I) of City CEQA Guidelines
summary: Request for authority to increase construction contingency and adjust funding for new gymnasium at Studio City Recreation Center.

details.action: request authority to increase construction contingency
